card.title: Productive Little Disaster
card.instruction: Treat every mistake or delay as a delightful chance to improve the plan, bond, or discover something better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shopping bag split. Lovely, now we can sort dinner before we get home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tomatoes are crushed. I wanted sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've accidentally started pasta sauce. You always say we should cook together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you let me handle the seasoning this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Try that chilli I always veto. I'll grate the cheese and learn to be surprised.
